players.name: Connor McDavid
players.note: The subject. Edmonton, two Finals in the window, both against Florida.

players.name: Nathan MacKinnon
players.note: The original peer. Same era, similar usage, won the Cup in 2022.

players.name: Leon Draisaitl
players.note: McDavid's own teammate: the same two Finals, the same opponent, the same supporting cast. Not an independent draw from 'elite forwards' -- a within-team control, which is exactly what makes him useful. Whatever Florida did to Edmonton, it was done to both of them.

players.name: Jack Eichel
players.note: Two Finals in the window against two different opponents (Florida in 2023, Carolina in 2026), one of them won. The only peer whose Finals sample is not a single series, and the only one who has faced the same Panthers team McDavid is confounded with.

players.name: Auston Matthews
players.note: No Finals appearance in the window -- Toronto has not been past the second round. Contributes to the earlier-round comparison only.

players.name: Sidney Crosby
players.note: No Finals appearance in the window, and only two playoff berths. The thinnest peer here; kept because dropping a peer for having a short playoff record is how a comparison group gets quietly curated.
